name: AXM Schema Identity Observatory
actions: scan bounded active JSON for exact schema identities
distinguish identical schema reuse from divergent same-id definitions
map schema references to locally observed definitions
summary: Read-only exact schema identity mapping across active Workshop JSON, with divergent same-ID definitions held visibly instead of guessed compatible.
notes: The observatory does not validate schema semantics, register schemas, infer compatibility, generate adapters, repair files, install modules, or change CANON.
